newsitem.title: BELGIUM: BELGACOM LAUNCHES INTERNATIONAL CALL PRE-PAID CARD.
newsitem.headline: BELGACOM LAUNCHES INTERNATIONAL CALL PRE-PAID CARD.

text.p: Belgian part privatised telecommunications company Belgacom said on Thursday it had launched a pre-paid card offering cheaper international calls from public telephone boxes.
The 200 or 500 Belgian franc "Phone Pass" cards offer 25 to 65 percent more call time for international calls to 28 countries, Belgacom said in a statement.
Belgacom is 49 percent owned by a consortium comprising Ameritech , Tele Danmark and Singapore Telecom and three Belgian financial companies.
